single.rationale: IRADIMED shows strong fundamentals with consistent revenue growth (16% CAGR), exceptional margins (77% gross, 31% operating), and market leadership in a niche MRI-compatible device market. However, the premium valuation (59x P/E, 77x P/FCF) and modest R&D spend (3.5% of revenue) alongside product transition risks (discontinuing 3860+ while ramping 3870) warrant caution before deeper commitment.

team.thesis: IRadimed holds a monopoly as the only known provider of MRI-compatible IV infusion pumps, achieving exceptional profitability with 76.7% gross margin and 31.2% operating margin while growing revenue at a 16.3% three-year CAGR from $53.3M to $83.8M, though the entire 2026 business depends on successfully transitioning from the legacy 3860+ system (being discontinued) to the newly FDA-cleared 3870 s
